programme.desc: Agarra-me Se Puderes desafia concorrentes de todo o país a colocarem à prova os seus conhecimentos numa corrida contra o tempo pela conquista do prémio final. O concurso combina cultura geral e competição num formato divertido para toda a família, com o anfitrião José Pedro Vasconcelos.

programme.title: Portugal em Rede
programme.desc: Programa de informação centrado no país e nas regiões. Revelar o Portugal que existe para além das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informação.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: A mais rigorosa seleção de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, João Adelino Faria, José Rodrigues dos Santos, Cristina Esteves e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo.

programme.title: A Prova dos Factos
programme.desc: Procurar a verdade, obriga a confrontar, investigar, perguntar... Estes são tempos de muitas opiniões e diferentes ângulos sobre os factos. E em cada investigação, só os Factos nos interessam. A verdade só chega quando se faz A Prova dos Factos e ela faz-se, agora, todas as sextas-feiras, na RTP.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um só objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do prémio máximo!

programme.title: Em Casa d'Amália
programme.desc: Que mais poderíamos pedir para o regresso deste programa, do que receber um dos poetas de Amália? Manuel Alegre, autor do icónico "Trova do Vento que Passa", estará connosco. A este raro momento, juntam-se também ilustres convidados: Paulo de Carvalho e o seu filho Agir, Rita Guerra e André Amaro...

programme.title: Espias
programme.desc: Ema envia uma carta a Larenz que relata o avistamento de tropas no Norte de África, mas que acaba por não chegar a tempo de impedir a invasão, para consternação dos alemães. Apesar disso e da suspeição de Rose, Larenz reitera a sua confiança em Ema.

programme.title: Ladrão e Polícia
programme.desc: Miles acaba de roubar um valioso diamante. Pouco antes de ser apanhado pela polícia consegue escondê-lo.

programme.title: Triplo 9
programme.desc: Um gangue de criminosos e polícias corruptos planeiam a morte de um polícia, com o objetivo de realizarem o seu maior golpe de sempre.

programme.title: Carro da Polícia
programme.desc: Dois miúdos encontram um carro da polícia abandonado e decidem aprender a guiá-lo. Mas quando o corrupto xerife da cidade decide reavê-lo, os três envolvem-se numa corrida eletrizante onde vale tudo.

programme.title: D-Tox
programme.desc: Jake Malloy, agente do FBI, foi testemunha da morte de algum dos seus companheiros, às mãos de um assassino de polícias. Quando este mata a sua namorada, Jake fica fora de si.

programme.title: Chovem almôndegas
programme.desc: O excêntrico inventor Flint Lockwood tem de evitar um desastre de grandes proporções, e de fazer crescer água na boca, depois de criar uma máquina que faz chover comida.

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Logo agora que pensávamos que era seguro voltar a entrar no duche! O terror regressa quando uma freira foragida (Diana Scarwid) com as mesmas iniciais de Marion Crane procura abriga no Motel Bates, espoletando o instinto assassino de Norman.

programme.title: A Troca
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1928. Christine Collins é uma mãe solteira cujo filho desaparece sem deixar rasto. Meses depois, a polícia comunica-lhe que encontrou a criança mas, assim que o vê, Christine sabe que não é o filho dela.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsessão
programme.desc: Telly Paretta é uma mulher que luta por superar a perda do seu filho de oito anos. Um dia, seu psicoterapeuta diz-lhe que o seu filho não é mais que um produto da sua imaginação.

programme.title: Dragão Vermelho
programme.desc: Um assassino como o Dr. Hannibal Lecter arranja sempre admiradores; criaturas pervertidas que regozijam com os detalhes dos seus crimes brutais.

programme.title: Coração de Dragão
programme.desc: No séc. X, um homem associa-se ao último dragão para lembrar às pessoas a existência de um antigo código de honra e inspirá-las a lutar pela liberdade contra um rei tirano.

programme.title: Fúria
programme.desc: Abril de 1945.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Um lote de heroína avaliada em cerca de 100 milhões de dólares é roubado do próprio depósito da polícia. O caso será encarregue aos agentes Burnett e Lowery, uma dupla muito peculiar pelos métodos que utilizam.

programme.title: O Último Vermeer
programme.desc: Enquanto Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), um judeu holandês, lutava na Resistência durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial, o espirituoso e afável conhecedor de arte Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) era anfitrião de saraus hedonistas e vendia tesouros de arte ho...

programme.title: A Troca
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1928. Christine Collins é uma mãe solteira cujo filho desaparece sem deixar rasto. Meses depois, a polícia comunica-lhe que encontrou a criança mas, assim que o vê, Christine sabe que não é o filho dela.

programme.title: Um homem furioso
programme.desc: H é um homem frio e misterioso, que trabalha para uma companhia responsável por transportar milhões de dólares todas as semanas em Los Angeles. Mas quando ele e o colega são alvos de uma tentativa de roubo, a sua verdadeira motivação é revelada...

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Após o divórcio, uma mãe e um pai continuam a tarefa partilhada de educar o seu filho mais novo através da adolescência e, finalmente, até à idade adulta.

programme.title: Na Linha de Fogo
programme.desc: Um agente veterano dos serviços secretos trabalha como guarda-costas do presidente dos Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Cães Danados
programme.desc: Joe Cabot (Lawrence Tierney), um experiente criminoso, reuniu seis bandidos para um grande roubo de diamantes, mas estes seis homens não sabem nada um sobre os outros e cada um utiliza uma cor como codinome.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial transporta milhares de pessoas para um planeta colónia, que tem uma avaria em uma de suas câmaras de sono.

programme.title: Em Defesa de Sua Majestade
programme.desc: Quando o pai de Chon é assassinado por um rebelde chinês que foge para Inglaterra, Chon e Roy decidem partir para Londres em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys 2
programme.desc: Lowrey e Bennett, agentes da brigada de Narcóticos, lideram a equipa que investiga o tráfico de ecstasy para Miami. As buscas levam-nos a um perigoso traficante, cujo plano para controlar todo o tráfico na cidade desencadeou uma guerra no submundo da droga.

programme.title: Triplo Nove
programme.desc: Um gangue de criminosos e polícias corruptos planeia a morte de um oficial da Polícia, de modo a poderem realizar o maior golpe de sempre na cidade.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Nesta adaptação a cinema de um bestseller de Dan Brown, o simbolista Robert Langdon acorda com amnésia e alia-se a uma médica que espera que o ajude a recuperar a memória. No processo encontra um trilho de pistas que o levam ao próprio Dante...

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Norman Bates apaixona-se por uma freira que esteve hospedada no Motel - o que deixa a sua "mãe" ciumenta - juntamente com um viajante e um jornalista curioso.

programme.title: Para além do Horizonte
programme.desc: Chris, Annie e os filhos formam uma família feliz. Mas Chris morre e vai para o Céu. Uns anos depois, Annie suicida-se e vai parar ao Inferno. Chris, que esperava por ela no Paraíso, parte numa jornada para a salvar. Filme vencedor de um Oscar® em 1999.

programme.title: Dragonheart: Coração de Dragão
programme.desc: Há muito, muito tempo, quando enormes dragões lançavam fogo e rasgavam os céus a grande altura, vivia um cavaleiro prestes a encontrar-se, de coração aberto, frente a frente com a criatura mais extraordinária que jamais existiu….

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: A Rapariga Dinamarquesa
programme.desc: História de amor inspirada na vida do casal dinamarquês, Lili Elbe e Gerda Wegener. O casamento e o trabalho de ambos ganha um novo sentido, à medida que vivem a arrebatadora viagem de Lili como a primeira transgénero. Filme vencedor de um Oscar® em 2016.

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Expulso do FBI, Mark Kaminsky é contratado pelo xerife de uma pequena cidade para matar o assassino do filho. Mas, para isso, Kaminsky tem de se infiltrar nos meandros da Máfia de Chicago.

programme.title: Dead Man Down - Um Homem a Abater
programme.desc: Victor, braço direito de Alphonse, líder de uma organização criminosa, é perseguido por alguém que está a matar os membros do gangue e que envia notas ameaçadoras. Darcy, que também trabalha para Alphonse, fica obcecado em apanhar o assassino.

programme.title: A Ilha das Cabeças Cortadas
programme.desc: Morgan, uma bonita pirata que navega sob as ordens de seu pai, decide partir em busca de um fabuloso tesouro indicado num mapa que este lhe entregou antes de morrer.

programme.title: O Último Vermeer
programme.desc: Um soldado e membro da resistência holandesa investiga arte roubada na sequência da Segunda Guerra Mundial, incluindo um Vermeer vendido aos nazis por um famoso falsificador.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo, hesita em acompanhar o velho amigo Coronel Trautman às linhas soviéticas no Afeganistão. Mas acabará por seguir, numa missão não-oficial de resgate na sequência da captura de Trautman.

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Os Croods
programme.desc: Uma aventura pré-histórica que acompanha a primeira família do Mundo. Depois de a caverna onde habitam ser destruída, os Croods iniciam uma viagem, durante a qual vão descobrir um incrível mundo novo, que lhes vai mudar a vida para sempre.

programme.title: Chovem Almôndegas
programme.desc: A última invenção de Flint Lockwood é um sucesso: ele faz chover comida do céu! Mas as coisas começam a correr mal quando, em vez de deliciosos hambúrgueres com queijo, começam a chover almôndegas gigantes, a alta velocidade, que ameaçam tudo e todos...

programme.title: Triplo Nove
programme.desc: Um gangue de criminosos e polícias corruptos planeia a morte de um oficial da Polícia, de modo a poderem realizar o maior golpe de sempre na cidade.

programme.title: Na Linha de Fogo
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan, agente dos Serviços Secretos, é perseguido pela culpa de não ter conseguido evitar a morte de Kennedy, nos anos 60. Quando um assassino lunático lhe liga, a ameaçar de morte o atual Presidente dos EUA, Frank faz tudo para o proteger.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys 2
programme.desc: Lowrey e Bennett, agentes da brigada de Narcóticos, lideram a equipa que investiga o tráfico de ecstasy para Miami. As buscas levam-nos a um perigoso traficante, cujo plano para controlar todo o tráfico na cidade desencadeou uma guerra no submundo da droga.

programme.title: Mare Vermelha

programme.title: Rapaz A

programme.title: Razão de Viver

programme.title: Amor Eterno
programme.desc: Kadir, Ömer, Asiye e Emel são a prova de que a união entre irmãos é capaz de reconstruir uma família. Depois de perderem o pai e a mãe, a vida continua a mostrar-lhes o lado mais sombrio.

programme.title: Êta Mundo Melhor
programme.desc: 'Êta Mundo Melhor!' tem como fio condutor a saga de Candinho, que vive na capital paulista, na mansão da mãe, Anastácia, a quem procurou durante toda a novela anterior. Apesar da riqueza que o cerca, ele enfrentará uma nova busca, em torno da qual a trama vai girar: a procura pelo filho perdido.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido
programme.desc: Halit começa a sentir-se atraído por Yildiz. Halit conhece o cirurgião plástico Sinan, um amigo da filha, numa festa, e logo surgem as piadinhas sobre a beleza das mulheres e o dinheiro dos maridos.

programme.title: A Força do Querer
programme.desc: Zu comenta com Marilda que acredita que Ritinha esteja a esconder algo da família. Cibele entrega para Ruy o resultado do exame de DNA de Ruyzinho. Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: At 2.17am, 17 children from the class of Justine Gandy run into the night, arms outstretched, never to be seen again. The only child from the class who remains safely in their bed is Alex Lilly. Distraught parent Archer Graff joins other members of the local community in pointing a finger of blame at Ms Gandy for the shocking turn of events. While she pleads innocence, school principal Andrew Marcus seeks answers along with police officer Paul Morgan. Horror, starring Julia Garner, Josh Brolin and Alden Ehrenreich.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: Bone Lake
programme.desc: A couple's holiday is upended when they're forced to share a mansion with a mysterious couple, spiralling into a maze of sex, lies and manipulation. Comedy thriller, starring Alex Roe and Maddie Hasson.

programme.title: 47 Metres Down
programme.desc: Two sisters vacationing in Mexico are trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean. With less than an hour of oxygen left and great white sharks circling nearby, they must fight to survive. Horror, starring Mandy Moore, Claire Holt and Matthew Modine.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen.

programme.title: The Accursed
programme.desc: A woman named Elly is asked by family friend Alma to look after an elderly lady living in a remote cabin for a few days. She agrees, but soon discovers there is a demon hiding in the woman, waiting to break free. Horror, starring Mena Suvari, Sarah Grey and Meg Foster.

programme.title: They Will Kill You
programme.desc: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a New York City high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realises the community is shrouded in mystery. Comedy horror, starring Zazie Beetz, Myha'la, Paterson Joseph and Tom Felton.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A palaeontologist, a game warden, a conspiracy theorist and a redneck sheriff each set out to investigate a mysterious death on the shore of a lake, only to find themselves up against a man-eating 30ft crocodile with an insatiable appetite. Comedy horror, starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson and Betty White.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of their small New England town. Part one of a two-part Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Bill Skarsgard, Jaeden Lieberher and Sophia Lillis.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Two teenage brothers move with their mother to a coastal town in California, where the eldest falls in with a local biker gang. He soon discovers that his new friends are vampires and he is turning into one himself, forcing his younger brother to team up with a pair of heavily armed comic shop employees to battle the undead and save his soul. Comedy horror, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Jason Patric, Dianne Wiest, Corey Feldman and Corey Haim.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by the diabolical Mr Reed. Horror, starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five students staying in a remote cabin find an ancient magical book, and unwittingly unleash evil spirits on the world. The dark forces they have conjured up possess them one by one, transforming them into ravenous zombies with an insatiable desire to feast on the living. Sam Raimi's horror, starring Bruce Campbell and Ellen Sandweiss.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Hapless Ash takes his girlfriend to a remote cabin in the woods, only for her to be killed and possessed by evil spirits. As a motley group of strangers turns up, they too find themselves under attack from demonic entities, leaving Ash the task of fending off the forces of darkness with his trusty chainsaw. Sam Raimi's comedy horror sequel, starring Bruce Campbell and Sarah Berry.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A palaeontologist, a game warden, a conspiracy theorist and a redneck sheriff each set out to investigate a mysterious death on the shore of a lake, only to find themselves up against a man-eating 30ft crocodile with an insatiable appetite. Comedy horror, starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson and Betty White.

programme.title: We Bury the Dead
programme.desc: When an experimental military weapon accidentally devastates Tasmania, volunteers travel to the island to help authorities identify the dead. Among them is a Ava Newman, who secretly hopes to find her missing husband. However, some of the bodies seem to be returning to life. Horror, starring Daisy Ridley, Brenton Thwaites and Mark Coles Smith.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Two teenage brothers move with their mother to a coastal town in California, where the eldest falls in with a local biker gang. He soon discovers that his new friends are vampires and he is turning into one himself, forcing his younger brother to team up with a pair of heavily armed comic shop employees to battle the undead and save his soul. Comedy horror, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Jason Patric, Dianne Wiest, Corey Feldman and Corey Haim.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by the diabolical Mr Reed. Horror, starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: The Woman in the Yard
programme.desc: Inside a rural farmhouse, painter Ramona Harris recuperates with a leg brace following a head-on car collision that claimed the life of her husband. Out of the blue, a woman in funereal garb materialises in a chair on the front lawn of the fixer-upper, and she has no intention of leaving. Psychological horror, starring Danielle Deadwyler, Peyton Jackson and Estella Kahiha.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Murderous alien beasties escape from their space prison and flee to Earth, where they wreak havoc in a sleepy Kansas village as they discover the delights of snacking on human flesh - and only two intergalactic bounty hunters look capable of saving the day. Madcap horror comedy, starring Dee Wallace Stone, M Emmet Walsh, Billy Green Bush and Scott Grimes.

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of scientists and a soldier of fortune comb the Borneo jungle for a rare species of orchid with valuable medicinal properties, but get more than they bargained when they encroach on the territory of a nest of gigantic and deadly snakes. Thriller, starring Johnny Messner, Matthew Marsden, KaDee Strickland and Nicholas Gonzalez.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: The Woman in the Yard
programme.desc: Inside a rural farmhouse, painter Ramona Harris recuperates with a leg brace following a head-on car collision that claimed the life of her husband. Out of the blue, a woman in funereal garb materialises in a chair on the front lawn of the fixer-upper, and she has no intention of leaving. Psychological horror, starring Danielle Deadwyler, Peyton Jackson and Estella Kahiha.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: Brightburn
programme.desc: A couple struggling to conceive a child think their prayers have been answered when an extra-terrestrial boy crash-lands on Earth. As he reaches puberty, they discover he has superhuman abilities, and begin to worry when it appears he won't harness his powers for good. Superhero horror, starring Elizabeth Banks, David Denman and Jackson A Dunn.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: God Forgives, I Don't
programme.desc: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
programme.desc: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: Gunslinger
programme.desc: When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown.

rating.system: Instituto de Cinematografía y de las Artes Visuales

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men -- John Morgan Candy (Bob Campbell), William Parcel Candy (Jonathan Haze), J.C. Haggard (Paul Birch), Hale Clinton (Touch Connors) and Govern Sturges (John Lund) -- are to travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach carrying Confederate traitor and spy Stephen Jethro (Jack Ingram) and gold. However, when they realize that a woman (Dorothy Malone) is also present, it complicates their mission.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli).

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Will (Gary Grimes), Les (Ron Howard) and Tod (Charlie Martin Smith), teenage farm boys living near the Mexican border, stumble upon Harry Spikes (Lee Marvin), a local bandit near death in the middle of nowhere. After helping bring the aging man back to health, the trio decide to escape their humdrum lives by becoming outlaws themselves. Failing at their first attempt to rob a bank, the boys convince the gruff Spikes to teach them the ways of the desperado.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Hour of the Gun
programme.desc: While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt (James Garner). Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead.

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: In this take on the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach) travels to Tombstone, Ariz., with prostitute Katie Elder (Faye Dunaway). Although the trip is difficult because Doc is ill with tuberculosis, they eventually reach their destination, where Holliday is reunited with his old friend Marshal Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin), who has been clashing with the Clanton gang. Tension between Earp and the Clantons rises until their infamous final showdown brings it to a head.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: During a bank robbery by the legendary James-Younger Gang, Ed Miller (Dennis Quaid) impulsively kills a man, much to the displeasure of leader Jesse James (James Keach), who insists that the gang scatter until the heat is off. The groups of brothers go their separate ways, with Cole Younger (David Carradine) considering settling down with his feisty girlfriend, Belle Starr (Pamela Reed). But they soon regroup for an ill-fated bank job in Northfield, Minn., that results in an epic chase.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A Fistful of Dynamite
programme.desc: At the beginning of the Mexican Revolution in 1913, greedy bandit Juan Miranda and idealist John H. Mallory, an Irish Republican Army explosives expert on the lam from the British, fall in with a band of revolutionaries plotting to strike a national bank. When it turns out that the government has been using the bank as a hiding place for illegally detained political prisoners, who are freed by the blast, Miranda becomes a revolutionary hero against his will.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: An aging rodeo rider (James Coburn) thinks more of himself than he does of his wife (Lois Nettleton), son and best friend (Slim Pickens).

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Proud warrior Navajo Joe (Burt Reynolds) is the only man left alive when outlaw Marvin Duncan (Aldo Sambrell) and his brutal gang destroy his village. Riding into a nearby town of white settlers, Joe announces his plans for vengeance, but the townspeople fear Duncan's retribution too much to stand behind him. In the course of his one-man battle against Duncan's small army for control of the town, Joe falls for beautiful maid Estella (Nicoletta Machiavelli).

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Three cowboy movie stars from the silent era -- Dusty Bottoms (Chevy Chase), Lucky Day (Steve Martin) and Ned Nederlander (Martin Short) -- are fired when one of their movies bombs. In what seems to be a career-saving offer, young Mexican woman Carmen (Patrice Martinez) offers them a high-paying gig in her village. The three jump at the opportunity, expecting to do their typical act, but Carmen believes they are really heroes and asks them to rid her village of bad guy El Guapo (Alfonso Arau).

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: A group of thieves rob a safe of $100,000 and plan to use the money to purchase some land near a proposed railway line. The crooks think they've gotten away with their crime, but they haven't figured on Sabata, a violent bounty hunter with no scruples and a strong desire for cash. He teams up with both his partner, Banjo, and a local bandit named Carrincha. Sabata's fast draw and quick wits make life hell for the thieves.

programme.title: Adios Sabata
programme.desc: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces.

programme.title: The Return of Sabata
programme.desc: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: During a drunken spree in the small Wild West town of Bannock, one of a half-dozen workers from a nearby ranch accidentally shoots an innocent man. Bannock's marshal, a righteous man named Jered Maddox (Burt Lancaster), comes to the larger town of Sabbath bearing the dead body of one of the revelers and demands the surrender of the remaining five from sheriff Cotton Ryan (Robert Ryan) and ranch owner Vincent Bronson (Lee J. Cobb), starting a confrontation that threatens to engulf them all.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

programme.title: The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: As the winter of 1867 approaches, Denver inhabitants led by chronic drunk Oracle Jones (Donald Pleasence), who has visions when inebriated, realize with horror that their supply of whiskey will run out before the snows melt. Oracle devises a plan to bring cases of whiskey from a distillery, but is thwarted at every turn. A temperance leader (Lee Remick), three Sioux Indians, and the U.S. Cavalry become interested in the shipment, and a sandstorm and quicksand add to the difficulties.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Upstanding widower "Big Eli" Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) decides to move from Kentucky further west to Texas. He undertakes the journey with just his young son "Little Eli" (Donald MacDonald), but en route they pick up friends like indentured servant Hannah (Dianne Foster) and schoolmarm Susie (Diana Lynn), a potential love interest. This motley crew's path is difficult, and they face many obstacles, not the least of which is nasty frontiersman Stan Bodine (Walter Matthau).

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Veracruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies.

programme.title: Comes a Horseman
programme.desc: Determined single woman Ella Connors (Jane Fonda) struggles to maintain her ranch despite constant attempts by Jacob "J.W." When oil companies begin pressuring both ranchers to allow drilling, Ella's position becomes even more perilous. Though Ella thinks she's scrappy enough to fight them on her own, her chances get better with the arrival of hunky war veteran Frank "Buck" Athearn (James Caan).

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Cattle rustlers Jack McKee (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil Colson (Sam Waterston) steadily steal cows from wealthy rancher John Brown (Clifton James). When his two hapless ranch hands (Harry Dean Stanton, Richard Bright) fail at capturing the thieves, Brown calls upon the services of Henry Beige (Slim Pickens), a cattle rustler turned detective -- although Beige does little more than sit around all day. But as they continue to get away with their crimes, McKee and Colson become a little too confident.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: In this movie based on a true story, Ned Kelly (Mick Jagger) has served a three-year prison sentence for stealing horses and is released. However, he cannot even begin to get his life in order before his mother (Clarissa Kaye) is arrested and falsely charged with murder. This is the last straw for Ned, who goes on a crime spree with his group, including Joe Byrne (Mark McManus) and Ned's brother, Dan (Allen Bickford). However, eventually the law catches up to them, forcing a fateful showdown.

programme.title: Return of the Seven
programme.desc: The residents of a Mexican village are intimidated by deranged rancher Lorca (Emilio Fernández), who assembles 50 gunmen to force the townspeople to construct a church in honor of his dead sons. Vigilante Chico (Julian Mateos), who previously teamed up with six other sharpshooters to protect the villagers in a time of need, learns of Lorca's harassment and decides to round up the old gang members, including Chris (Yul Brynner) and Vin (Robert Fuller), and ride in to save the town again.

programme.title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: When Quintero (Fernando Rey), a Mexican revolutionary leader, is left to rot in jail by the forces of President Diaz, it's up to his subordinate, Max (Reni Santoni), to bust him out. With $600 in hand, he crosses the border into America and hires Chris Adams (George Kennedy), a mercenary of considerable skill, who uses the rest of the cash on more hired guns. After the team is rounded out by experts on close-combat fighting, explosives and knife-throwing, they set off to free Quintero.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: Erstwhile gunslinger Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) has put his rowdy days behind him, settling down with a wife (Mariette Hartley) and serving as the sheriff of his town in the Arizona territory. So when his old pal Jim Mackay (Ralph Waite) asks for help defending the border town of Magdalena, Mexico, from a marauding bandit named De Toro, Chris refuses. It's only after De Toro's gang kidnaps Chris's wife that he changes his mind, enlisting a cutthroat gang of prisoners to help him.

programme.title: Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: Harvard graduate James Averill (Kris Kristofferson) is the sheriff of prosperous Jackson County, Wyo., when a battle erupts between the area's poverty-stricken immigrants and its wealthy cattle farmers. The politically connected ranch owners fight the immigrants with the help of Nathan Champion (Christopher Walken), a mercenary competing with Averill for the love of local madam Ella Watson (Isabelle Huppert). As the struggle escalates, Averill and Champion begin to question their decisions.

programme.title: Wild Bill
programme.desc: Gunfighter Wild Bill Hickok (Jeff Bridges) travels the frontier, gaining fame and enemies in roughly equal measure. He sometimes meets up with his friend and occasional lover, Calamity Jane (Ellen Barkin), and he headlines for a while in a traveling circus. Along the way, he meets Susannah (Diane Lane), his one true love, but spurns her for the outlaw life. With his health deteriorating, Bill rides into Deadwood, S.D., as his past catches up to him.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: When an aging Wild Bill Hickok (Charles Bronson) finds his dreams invaded by the image of a rampaging white buffalo, he decides the only remedy is to find and kill the creature. Sioux Chief Crazy Horse (Will Sampson) has recently lost a daughter to the white buffalo, and he fears the girl's soul won't rest until he kills it.

programme.desc: Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: When diphtheria breaks out at Fort Humboldt, a train is dispatched with medical supplies and relief troops. Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) is an American rifleman who travels to the Australian outback to answer a help-wanted ad calling for a sharpshooter. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge.

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
programme.desc: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang.

programme.desc: Apache Natives are after Ellen (Bibi Andersson), her baby, and her husband, William (Dennis Weaver). programme.desc: In Cuba, a band of Buffalo Soldiers, led by the intrepid Jesse Lee (Mario Van Peebles) and joined by a gambling white soldier (Stephen Baldwin), is sent on a suicide mission to intercept a shipment of gold from enemy troops during the Spanish-American War. programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. programme.desc: Emmy-winning funnyman Jimmy Kimmel serves up comedy bits and welcomes guests that include other comics, celebrities, athletes and musicians, as well as everyday people with unusual or compelling personal stories. Kimmel's family and friends take part in the festivities, including his Cousin Sal, Uncle Frank (until his death in 2011) and childhood friend Cleto Escobedo III, who leads the show's house band. Recurring segments include the FCC-pleasing This Week in Unnecessary Censorship in which they take TV clips and "bleep and blur things whether they need it or not," as Kimmel describes it. But it's too bad they consistently run out of time for Matt Damon's segment.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.title: Heartland

Follow young Amy Fleming as she slowly discovers she possesses her now-deceased mother's ability to aid injured horses as well as maintaining good relationships with those who are trying to get by one day at a time. The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.

programme.title: The Man Who Skied Down Everest
programme.desc: This Oscar-winning documentary tells the story behind Japanese daredevil Yuichiro Miura's 1970 effort to ski down the world's tallest mountain. Miura's trek to the top of Everest provides much of the film's drama, as several members of his climbing team die in the process. The arduous trek gives way to footage of Miura's stunning descent, which requires him to use a parachute to control his speed. The action is supplemented by passages from the journal Miura kept during the adventure.

programme.title: Brother, Can You Spare a Dime?
programme.desc: The Great Depression, in both its bleak lows and its artistic highs, is presented in this documentary. Featuring the grim reality that many Americans faced during the era, largely in the form of newsreel clips, the film also depicts how Hollywood dealt with this period of widespread poverty and unemployment. Much of the movie footage showcases glamour and extravagance, providing lively moments of escapism that contrast starkly with day-to-day life during the 1930s.

After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads.

programme.title: In Old Caliente
programme.desc: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: The Carson City Kid
programme.desc: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid.

programme.title: Driftin' River
programme.desc: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

programme.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
programme.desc: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
programme.desc: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
programme.desc: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

programme.title: Live!

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Charter boat captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker combine their distinctly different fishing styles and skills to produce this action-packed offshore fishing series. Rodger has a lifetime of fishing and diving experience in the waters surrounding the Florida Keys, and many "Into the Blue" episodes feature his underwater videography as he hunts for the ocean's predators. Walker is a proven performer in big-game billfish tournaments and has fished the waters of the Florida Keys and the Mid-Atlantic for more than 25 years. Together, in the search for yellowfin tuna, red snapper, sharks, sailfish, mahi-mahi or marlin, they demonstrate how to make an offshore fishing adventure a success.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Journey back 40,000 years and discover the great beasts of the Ice Age with Professor Alice Roberts. Alice's Ice Age odyssey begins in the land of the Sabre-tooth, North America, a continent that was half-covered by ice, up to two miles thick. Yet, it also boasts the most impressive cast of Ice Age Giants in the world.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Alice ventures to the parts of the Northern Hemisphere, hit the hardest by the cold - Europe and Siberia. High in the mountains of Transylvania, a cave sealed for thousands of years reveals grisly evidence for a fight to the death between two starving giants, a cave bear and a cave lion. Yet Alice discovers that for woolly rhinos and woolly mammoths, the Ice Age created a bounty.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Even after thousands of years of ice crushing the Northern Hemisphere and temperatures of 20 degrees lower than those of today, many of the great giants of the Ice Age still walked the earth. It was only when the world had warmed up again that mammoths, woolly rhinos, sabre-toothed cats and giant ground sloths finally became extinct. Professor Alice Roberts sets off on her last voyage back to the Ice Age to discover why.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Steve is going large, as he focuses on the biggest animals to have ever walked the earth. In his dino-den, he starts by meeting the Argentinosaurus, an animal so large that even its poo was deadly. But if you thought that that was the biggest dinosaur ever, then think again.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The Jurassic was home to the most vicious and violent predators the world has ever seen. To survive, herbivores had to fight back! Steve Backshall goes on a mission to track down the deadliest of all dinosaur defenders. He'll meet the armoured tank that is Nodosaurus, he'll test whether an Iguanodon really has what it takes to beat a T-rex, and thanks to some mega-engineering he'll unleash an Ankylosaurus tail-swinging robot that goes on the rampage and then some!

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Steve tries to chomp through a car like a T. rex, wield an axe like an Allosaurus and hitch a ride in Britain's biggest tank to showcase the might of a Spinosaurus.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Steve discovers just what it takes to be a terror from the skies. He straps himself into one of Britain's fastest wind tunnels where he goes head-to-head against Microraptor.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Steve travels to new depths as he discovers just what it takes to be an aquatic terror. His quest sees him rocket through water in spectacular style, just like an Ophthalmosaurus.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs

Strap yourself in for a sensory overload!

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs

programme.title: Multitude of Counselors
programme.desc: Joseph Strong, a very tall 53 year-old retired policeman of Irish descent, strides into the office and warmly says hello in a deep bass voice. He sits down in the chair and begins to explain his situation, immediately melting into tears that continue to flow for most of the session. He explains that he can’t control his temper, and then can’t shake the feelings of despair that linger after he explodes. For instance, he exploded when a neighbor insulted his dog, but immediately regretted losing his temper. Now he feels deep shame and remorse and wants to learn anger management.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy
programme.sub-title: Testimonio personal del Pr. José Feliciano Castillo Lugo
programme.desc: En esta inspiradora entrevista, el Pastor José Feliciano Castillo Lugo comparte profundamente su testimonio personal. Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

programme.desc: Blink and you'll miss it. It's a cliche that holds true in many magic tricks, which often have the magical part of the illusion happen in a split second, which is how this show got its name. programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: The vintage sci-fi comic strip character gets a 21st-century makeover in this freewheeling adaptation that sends All-American track star Steven "Flash" Gordon on a series of wild adventures that begins when he falls through an interdimensional rift in space and lands on the planet Mongo, accompanied by his old flame from high school, Dale Arden. Flash is looking for clues to the fate of his father, the eminent scientist Dr. Lawrence Gordon, previously believed to have died in a laboratory fire several years earlier. His quest, however, leads him into the clutches of Ming, the evil ruler of Mongo, and his devious daughter, Aura. Flash escapes back to Earth, vowing to foil the ruthless Ming's threat to humanity. Fortunately, in addition to Dale, Flash can count on help from Baylin, a beautiful but tough intergalactic bounty hunter, and Hans Zarkov, the eccentric former associate of Flash's father.
